title: Repository cleanup: one source for each fact
description:
Approved by Antonio on 2026-11-16, after the heca-web team (setting up the new documentation site in ../heca-web) found discrepancies in the repo.

Rules agreed:
- The planner is the only source for work status. BACKLOG.md and .planning/ (the old GSD tool) go.
- README becomes a short landing page.
- Detailed documentation lives once, in docs/, which heca-web will use as its source.
- Technical facts such as the terminal stack live in one place, linked from elsewhere.
- book/ and docs/book.toml are left alone; heca-web replaces them.
- Nothing open is lost: open items in BACKLOG.md and .planning/ are checked against the planner before deletion, and any gaps go to Antonio.

tasks.title: Remove BACKLOG and .planning, slim README to a landing page, one place for the terminal stack
tasks.description:
Antonio approved each point on 2026-11-16, after a verification of the heca-web team's findings (report: A, D, E, F confirmed; G docs accurate).

## What exists (verified 2026-11-16)
- **BACKLOG.md** (2664 lines) is still presented as a live source:
  - its "How to use this file" header;
  - AGENTS.md:460 ("Track pending gaps in the plan (e.g. BACKLOG …)");
  - docs/plugins.md:512 and docs/hint-architecture.md:52, which cite BACKLOG.md:1490;
  - .planner/resume.json:11-12.
  - About 12 references in total outside BACKLOG.md itself.
- **.planning/** is the old GSD planning tool (last change 2026-10-21): PROJECT.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, ROADMAP.md, research/, phases/, archive/, config.json, interaction-policy-plan.md.
  - It is referenced by AGENTS.md:1953 ("Read .planning/research/ARCHITECTURE.md … first"), README.md:2438, BACKLOG.md, compositor-blur-refactor-plan.md, plans/01-sidebar-and-actions.md and old .planner/docs handoffs.
  - ROADMAP marks shipped work (sessions, RPC, palette) as Pending.
- **README.md** is 2452 lines and duplicates docs/ topics; some facts already diverge: the terminal stack, and the roadmap calling shipped sessions/socket "Planned".
- **The terminal stack is wrong in several places.** The truth is wezterm-term (+ wezterm-surface) over portable-pty (heca-core/Cargo.toml). Wrong statements:
  - README.md:78 and :2370 ("vte");
  - AGENTS.md:1162 Stack table (`alacritty_terminal`) and AGENTS.md:1616;
  - .planning/ROADMAP.md:103 and PROJECT.md.

## To do
1. **Check before deleting.** List every still-open item in BACKLOG.md and every still-valid requirement, decision or plan in .planning/, and check each against the planner (.planner/ JSON). Write the result to a report.
   - If anything open is missing from the planner, STOP and give the list to the orchestrator, who brings it to Antonio, before deleting anything.
   - If nothing is missing, delete BACKLOG.md and the whole .planning/ folder.
2. **Remove every reference** to BACKLOG.md and .planning/ across the repo: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README, docs/, root plan files, and .planner text only through the planner MCP (never by editing JSON). Rewrite the sentence rather than leave a dead pointer. Where AGENTS.md says to read .planning first, point to the planner and docs/.
3. **One place for the terminal stack.** Choose docs/architecture.md (or the existing architecture doc) as the single owner, with the correct wezterm-term + portable-pty facts. AGENTS.md's Stack table either links there or is corrected, without duplicating version facts that drift. Remove the technical stack from the README.
4. **README as a landing page:** what heca is, install, first run, the key ideas in a few lines, and a link to the documentation (docs/, later the heca-web site). Every detailed section moves into docs/: configuration, keybindings, sessions, architecture, roadmap. A topic already covered in docs/ is merged there with no loss. The roadmap points to the planner.
5. Leave book/ and docs/book.toml alone; heca-web replaces them.

## Checks
- No remaining reference to BACKLOG or .planning (grep, excluding target/ and book/).
- No fact lost from the README; a list of where each moved section went.
- Docs-only change: tests unaffected, `cargo doc` clean if any doc comments change.
